entries.message: This update adds Simkl, Netflix imports and multi-user accounts, while improving sync, navigation and mobile layouts.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Connect Simkl without a personal Client ID to sync watch history and ratings alongside Trakt, with a reviewable first sync and on-demand checks.
Feature: Create multiple user accounts with administrator-managed access, keeping each person's data and sessions separate.
Feature: Use the Plekt Emby and Jellyfin plugins for media-server events, with setup guides for each plugin and the webhook alternative.
Feature: Import Netflix viewing history from a CSV or personal-information ZIP, choose a profile, review matches and import selected watches with their original dates.
Feature: Browse cast filmographies with Movies and TV Shows tabs and year and genre filters.
Feature: Watch History offers a Days view, grouping watches by date, alongside the existing Cards view.
Feature: Drop and restore titles from Up Next or their detail pages; filter dropped titles and see their count in Stats.
Feature: Enable AniDB titles and descriptions for anime, review matches, and safely match titles with a single supported link.
Feature: Subscribe to upcoming movie and TV releases using a private calendar feed; regenerate the URL to revoke the old one.
Fix: Up Next and Recently Watched refresh across open dashboards and devices, and returning to the dashboard shows cached cards while fresh results load.
Fix: Resume sync preserves newer stop positions, avoids repeated Plex resume updates and restores eligible Emby Continue Watching items.
Fix: Jellyfin webhook events recognize dashed user IDs, and the higher webhook rate limit accommodates bursts.
Tweak: Add sidebar links to Discord and Reddit, with an option to hide project links.
Tweak: Review confirmed TV episode numbering conflicts in Manual Watch, with a count and dismiss action that leaves watch state unchanged.
Tweak: Setup guides explain the Plekt Emby and Jellyfin plugins and their webhook alternatives, and warn against enabling both.
Tweak: Media server cards in the setup wizard show their logos, and backup options are grouped into local and remote sections.
Tweak: Setup cards and status indicators follow Settings styling in both themes, with clearer tracker and import progress.
Tweak: Library pages show loading progress, retain the first page while refreshing and preserve distinct titles sharing artwork.
Tweak: Desktop navigation and library controls remain visible without empty action space.
Tweak: Opening Info from a scrolled media page keeps the header visible and closes the Options menu.
Tweak: On phones, featured Up Next and Now Playing cards have larger posters, and Up Next actions use a compact toolbar.
Tweak: Opened Watchlist, Ratings and Watch History posters retain their folded size on phones.
Tweak: Phone layouts improve cast profiles, TV library cards, Discover and Playlists rows, and the timeline live panel.
Tweak: Playing sessions show a Now playing label, while paused sessions retain their Paused label.
Tweak: Settings shows plain connection statuses and keeps Help cards compact until expanded.
Tweak: First-run tracker imports can run in parallel and start an add-only outward sync with progress and held-item counts.
Tweak: Tautulli and Netflix imports are grouped under One Time Imports in Settings.
Tweak: Opening Settings no longer automatically requests Seerr capabilities.
Tweak: Webhook rate limits allow larger media-server event bursts.
Tweak: Installation steps remain readable on phones in both themes.
Tweak: Trakt errors and restore conflicts show safe messages, and security-related dependencies have been updated.

details: Fix: A title that is playing live no longer also appears as its own part watched card in Now Playing or the Up Next rail

entries.message: This update improves watch state and season matching, restyles the appearance and login page, and hides Card Art on media detail pages.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Add TV season source selection, episode translation, unmatched episode handling, and translated Up Next warmup.
Tweak: Preserve completed Plex watch state across stale resume data and protect unwatch races.
Tweak: Preserve Trakt-only plays during show replacement and fail closed on occupied targets.
Tweak: Split sync, history import, polling, and scheduling work into focused modules with retry and lease safeguards.
Tweak: Improve appearance controls, changelog navigation, Reddit release bundling, and README screenshots.
Tweak: Re-check suspected Plex unwatches against live metadata and keep cached episode state aligned, preventing stale reports from reaching manual watch review.
Tweak: Keep TV season-source choice and watch-impact confirmation beside search controls, with less blank space across phone, tablet, and desktop.
Tweak: Use provider-neutral empty-season messaging when episode lists are unavailable while preserving TV and movie match results.
Tweak: Modern is the only look; the Classic style and its switch are removed.
Tweak: Card Art checkbox added to the Appearance menu (hidden on media detail pages); Background Art checkbox only on the Dashboard and details pages.
Tweak: Appearance menu rows match the media option rows with icons, and Text size sits at the bottom.
Tweak: Buttons use a neutral default state in both themes; hover changes only text and border.
Tweak: Spoiler toggle no longer tints the whole button when checked; only the checkbox shows the state.
Tweak: Settings use two brand surfaces in both themes, aligned with the left menu.
Tweak: Dashboard and settings surfaces aligned with the left menu.
Tweak: Navbar on every page uses the left-menu tone, not only media pages.
Tweak: About card uses the left-menu tone in both themes.
Tweak: Left-menu search is an underline field in light mode, as in dark.
Tweak: Light-mode changelog entries use the white panel tone.
Tweak: Softer outline on the selected settings section.
Tweak: Onboarding and sign-in footer theme toggle shows the Light and Dark words only.
Tweak: Login panel uses the left-menu tone and its fields use the main-background tone.
Tweak: Login heading reads "Please log in"; the long intro text is removed.
Tweak: "Forgot your password?" sits right-aligned under the password field.
Tweak: Sign-in fields no longer show the default focus outline.
Tweak: Show and movie posters now use provider artwork when a saved local image is unavailable.
Tweak: Card Art is no longer offered in the Appearance menu on media detail pages, which have no cards to show it on.
